scope: Jordan medical discovery — Jordan University of Science and Technology Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: JUST's Faculty of Medicine lists a 2026 Bachelor of Doctor of Medicine (MD) programme and provides its programme plan.

The current JUST admission page lists the international Doctor of Medicine route with a 90.00 minimum average, 257 plan credit hours, USD 500 per credit hour, USD 250 admission fee, USD 464 semester fee and USD 75 application fee.
JUST's 2026 MD programme plan shows university and Faculty of Medicine compulsory requirements and course-level teaching methods.
JUST's official Faculty of Medicine site describes King Abdullah University Hospital as its teaching hospital in student testimony and reports current faculty-hospital activity.

holdReasons: No independent current programme recognition/accreditation evidence was established for the necessary recognition badges.

The official international application information establishes headline thresholds and fees but a complete current requirements, timeline, clinical-placement and student-living packet was not completed.
The programme is labelled 'B.Sc of Doctor of Medicine (MD)' on JUST pages, requiring authoritative degree-award clarification before a public medical-degree payload.
nextAction: Confirm current programme recognition/accreditation and degree-award wording, then complete authoritative international admissions, clinical and accommodation/support evidence before packaging.
